description.zh: 目标 IP 地址，用于匹配作业的目标写入地址
description.en: The destination IP address. This parameter is used to match the destination sink address of a job.

description.zh: 目标端口，配合 dstIp 使用
description.en: The destination port. Use this parameter with dstIp.

description.zh: 是否忽略返回结果中的作业摘要信息，仅返回Deployment部署作业信息，用于提升性能
description.en: Specifies whether to exclude the job summary from the response. If you exclude the summary, only deployment information is returned. This improves performance.

description.zh: 是否忽略资源配置信息，减少返回数据体积
description.en: Specifies whether to exclude resource configuration information. This reduces the size of the returned data.

description.zh: 源 IP 地址，用于匹配作业的输入源地址
description.en: The source IP address. This parameter is used to match the input source address of a job.

description.zh: 源端口，配合 srcIp 使用，精确匹配连接
description.en: The source port. Use this parameter with srcIp for an exact match of the connection.

descriptions.zh: 本接口用于通过网络连接中的 源 IP 与端口或 目标 IP 与端口 查询关联的 Flink 已部署作业。
descriptions.en: Use this operation to query for associated Flink deployments based on the source or destination IP address and port of a network connection.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ververica get-deployments-by-ip --workspace a14bd5d90a0000 --namespace default-namespace --src-ip 192.168.1.100 --src-port 54321 --dst-ip 10.100.2.200 --dst-port 9092 --ignore-job-summary false --ignore-resource-setting false --api-version 2022-07-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ververica GET /api/v2/namespaces/default-namespace/deployments/getDeployments/byIp --region cn-hangzhou --srcIp '192.168.1.100' --dstPort 9092 --srcPort 54321 --dstIp '10.100.2.200' --ignoreJobSummary false --ignoreResourceSetting false --header "workspace=a14bd5d90a0000" --header "Content-Type=application/json"
